Bea (CS): FYI MediTrak's onboarding questionnaire included a vendor-risk PDF that asks for: SOC2 scope list, data residency for embeddings, list of subprocessors, and confirmation of deletion SLA. We need to respond with a short-form package by next Tue.
Marco (Security): I'll pull the scope list and a one-page tenant isolation sketch. Do we need to include a risk rating?
Jess (Solutions): Not necessary unless they ask. I can add config pointers + the ticket where we enabled tenant tagging (TCK-1299).
Ola (Legal): I'll prepare a copy-paste DPA paragraph for subprocessors. Also note: if they insist on BYOK we need an ops lead to confirm.
Bea (CS): ask: Derek  can MediTrak accept a redacted network diagram?
Derek (MediTrak): yes redacted is fine, prefer a single PDF with bullets. can you also confirm embeddings retention and whether embeddings are part of exports?
Marco (Security): embeddings retention default 90d; exports include embeddings only if customer requests a full data export; deletion request will remove embeddings as part of the export flow. I'll add a 1-liner to the PDF.
Jess (Solutions): I'll upload a "config-pointers.txt" with `TCK-1299` and a short note on RBAC.
OnboardBot: Checklist created /onboarding/renewals/MediTrak/2026-quickpack (due 2026-04-07T23:59:00Z). Assigned: Marco, Jess, Ola.
Marco (Security): uploaded "tenant-scope-sketch.pdf" (redacted).
Jess (Solutions): uploaded "config-pointers.txt" and link to ticket https://rwd.example.com/tickets/TCK-1299
Ola (Legal): uploaded "dpa-paragraph.txt" (2 sentences, non-contracting).
Bea (CS): I'll make the single PDF and ping Derek Tue AM with the package. thanks all. :wave:
